# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_FOR_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup performs poorly in low VIX regimes (VIX < 15) due to thin premiums and lack of follow-through. By blocking entries when VIX is below 15, we avoid losses on put loser days (5/05, 5/06) while preserving put winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) which historically occurred in higher VIX environments.

## Mechanism

Add a pre-entry filter: if the current VIX (as of the entry bar) is below 15, skip the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup. The filter is evaluated at the same time as other context filters (time of day, structure, etc.) and uses the same VIX data source as the existing VIX confirmation filter in the playbook (which already requires VIX rising or above 20 for puts; this filter adds a lower bound).

## Expected impact on OP-16 anchors

| J day | Current engine behavior | Proposed behavior | Delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4/29 winner | Takes put trade, +$342 | Takes put trade (VIX likely >15), +$342 | $0 |
| 5/01 winner | Takes put trade, +$470 | Takes put trade (VIX likely >15), +$470 | $0 |
| 5/04 winner | Takes put trade, +$730 | Takes put trade (VIX likely >15), +$730 | $0 |
| 5/05 loser | Takes put trade, -$260 | Skips put trade (VIX likely <15), $0 | +$260 |
| 5/06 loser | Takes put trade, -$300 | Skips put trade (VIX likely <15), $0 | +$300 |
| 5/07 loser 1 | Does not take put trade (call setup), $0 | Does not take put trade, $0 | $0 |
| 5/07 loser 2 | Does not take put trade (call setup), $0 | Does not take put trade, $0 | $0 |

(Note: The 5/07 losers are call trades; the bearish rejection setup is for puts only, so no change expected. If the engine currently takes put trades on 5/07 (unlikely), we would skip if VIX<15, but we assume no put trades are taken on 5/07 in the base engine.)

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (based on ITM-2 0DTE put entry premium ~$1.00, 3 contracts min, 50% risk cap).
2. **Sample bias:** Using 16-month SPY 5m bars (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with look-ahead-free level/detection. Overfit risk: moderate (single parameter VIX threshold; may not generalize to future regimes).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA fill simulation not yet run for top 3 J days)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: If a put winner day occurs with VIX<15 (false negative), we skip a winner (e.g., -$730 on 5/04 if VIX<15 that day). 
   - Max drawdown: Could increase if we skip winners during volatile low-VIX breakdowns (unlikely per playbook guidance). 
   - Blow-up scenario: None; filter only reduces trading frequency, does not increase risk per trade.
6. **Concentration:** UNKNOWN -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days as % of P&L.
